source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Complete a three-tile 2x2 reflection pattern."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != 0]

    def spans(size, lines):
        out, start = [], 0
        for line in lines:
            out.append((start, line))
            start = line + 1
        out.append((start, size))
        return out

    def common_length(parts):
        counts = Counter(b-a for a, b in parts)
        return max(counts, key=lambda n: (counts[n], n))

    rs = spans(h, hlines)
    cs = spans(w, vlines)
    rh, cw = common_length(rs), common_length(cs)
    rs = [(a,b) for a,b in rs if b-a == rh]
    cs = [(a,b) for a,b in cs if b-a == cw]
    tiles = [[ [row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]] for c0,c1 in cs] for r0,r1 in rs]

    def pattern(tile):
        return {(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(tile) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0}

    def flip(p, vertical, horizontal):
        return {(rh-1-r if vertical else r, cw-1-c if horizontal else c, v) for r,c,v in p}

    nr, nc = len(tiles), len(tiles[0])
    for tr in range(nr-1):
        for tc in range(nc-1):
            cells = [(dr,dc,pattern(tiles[tr+dr][tc+dc])) for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2)]
            present = [(dr,dc,p) for dr,dc,p in cells if p]
            missing = [(dr,dc) for dr,dc,p in cells if not p]
            if len(present) != 3 or len(missing) != 1:
                continue
            bases = []
            for dr,dc,p in present:
                bases.append(flip(p, bool(dr), bool(dc)))
            base = bases[0]
            if any(p != base for p in bases[1:]):
                continue
            dr,dc = missing[0]
            target = flip(base, bool(dr), bool(dc))
            r0,r1 = rs[tr+dr]
            c0,c1 = cs[tc+dc]
            for r,c,v in target:
                g[r0+r][c0+c] = v
    return g
'''
